observation: Independently green city roots collided during integrated collection.
hypothesis: Same-named modules are imported globally until package boundaries exist.
recommended_action: Run a narrow collect-only integration gate before the unchanged full suite.

observation: A city scenario used RAIN while the UI catalog and closed enum used FLOOD-only vocabulary.
hypothesis: Lane-local tests did not compare UI identifiers against the shared runtime.
recommended_action: Assert UI source IDs, scenario IDs, and hazard types against the shared city-pack runtime before packaging.

observation: The same private-plan capability returned HTTP 403 for ruleset and branch-protection attempts in the human-reviewed prior run.
hypothesis: Retrying unchanged APIs cannot create the missing plan capability and only consumes the repair budget.
recommended_action: Do not retry until capability changes; use the explicitly limited local pre-push guard, isolated worktrees, approved branch namespaces, draft PR, Hosted CI, and human-only main merge while reporting SERVER_SIDE_BRANCH_PROTECTION=false.

observation: A stale external virtualenv launcher failed, and pytest's default base temporary directory was inaccessible after the environment was recreated.
hypothesis: External environment state and inherited temporary-directory ACLs are not repository failures.
recommended_action: Recreate an external virtualenv strictly from project metadata and use a unique external --basetemp with cacheprovider disabled; never modify tracked dependency metadata to mask the environment problem.

observation: The full suite exposed a fixture that labelled an install as fresh while retaining a pre-existing CRLF hook.
hypothesis: A test lifecycle precondition must be established explicitly rather than inferred from the checkout newline mode.
recommended_action: Remove only the disposable fixture hook before the fresh-install action, then run targeted and unchanged full tests; never alter the real installed hook to satisfy the fixture.

observation: Independent review found that hashes proved retained bytes but did not authorize geometry connection, and a serialized UNKNOWN mapping could agree with a caller scenario while contradicting the referenced official artifact.
hypothesis: Metadata verification, geometry validation, and model derivation need distinct unforgeable capabilities with relationship checks repeated at every public loader boundary.
recommended_action: Require ValidatedGeometryIndex for geometry-referenced observations; bind edge IDs, scenario source IDs, hazard types, immutable payload bytes, and static elapsed=null at derive and deserialize boundaries; preserve UNKNOWN when coverage authority is absent.

observation: The external environment did not contain jsonschema and the task prohibited adding dependencies.
hypothesis: Schema is a structural interchange precheck while runtime loaders remain the normative relational validator.
recommended_action: Use standard-library parsing, exact schema-shape assertions, a narrowly scoped test evaluator for the schema keywords in this fixture, and runtime negative tests; do not modify dependency metadata.

observation: A regex-only UTC timestamp validator accepted structurally shaped but impossible calendar dates.
hypothesis: Lexical form and calendar validity are separate invariants.
recommended_action: Validate the exact UTC lexical contract and parse the calendar value before accepting provenance; retain a negative regression test for impossible dates.

observation: The targeted suite printed all passing progress but remained alive for more than 120 seconds when it inherited the default Windows temp and pytest cache state.
hypothesis: The already-known inaccessible or stale inherited temp/cache boundary can also present as a post-result exit stall rather than an immediate permission error.
recommended_action: Interrupt only the stalled test process, use a new external --basetemp with cacheprovider disabled, then run targeted and full tests unchanged; do not alter repository dependencies or tests to hide the environment fault.

observation: Independent review found that a green fixture round trip compared already-lossy internal state, while maint_date and missing/99 distinctions were not completely preserved and arbitrary sidecar payloads could cross the SOURCE_FACT/ABLEPATH_DESIGN boundary.
hypothesis: A permissive sidecar plus fixture-only equality can hide semantic loss even when top-level keys are exact.
recommended_action: Keep the production adapter disabled; before retry, freeze exact internal and sidecar schemas, preserve every BIDIRECTIONAL field and UNKNOWN kind, reject all unmapped values, and mutation-test import-export against original source facts.

observation: A city lane passed before commit, but integration checkout under core.autocrlf changed retained JSON, query, and normalized GeoJSON bytes to CRLF, causing two manifest hash tests to fail.
hypothesis: Hash-bound text requires its checkout byte policy to be part of the versioned provenance contract; clean-filter equality alone does not prove raw working bytes.
recommended_action: List each reviewed text artifact as an exact text eol=lf path, never use a directory-wide text rule that could capture future binary data, re-checkout after the attribute commit, and compare working bytes, HEAD blob bytes, and manifest SHA before targeted and full tests.
